Usage: drive record restate --if-unanswered=IF-UNANSWERED <ask> [flags]

Record what an open ask waits on now, once its session closed or its change merged.

When status gives an ask a "since" line and the ask still holds something,
such as a production write or a message, restate it: say what it waits on
now, as the owner reads it on the page. One that holds nothing is moot
instead (record answer --took moot).

Arguments:
  <ask>                The open ask, such as A3.

Flags:
      --if-unanswered=IF-UNANSWERED
                       What happens while nobody answers, as it stands now (required).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
      --batch=NAME     Act in this batch, as drive prints its name, instead of the driver's current
                       one. It may stand anywhere on the line.
      --driver=NAME    Act in the batch this driver drives now; a chat driver's name is its
                       webhook's. It may stand anywhere on the line.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    refused: nothing was done; next: says what to run instead
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  3    tried and did not end as asked; the message says what did happen
  4    the session's login was rejected; next: relaunches it on another account, or says to tell the
       owner
